20 /**
21  * Perform intake, durably emit the Stage-0 triage artifact (+ extension), then prompt.
22  * @param {object} inputs The intake data.
23  * @param {object} options
24  * @param {string} options.runDir Directory to write the artifact to.
25  * @param {function} options.promptHuman Async function to prompt the human (returns 'APPROVE', 'EDIT', or 'ABORT').
26  * @param {function} options.onBeforePrompt Optional callback before the prompt (used for testing crash-before-prompt).
27  * @param {string} [options.confirmedDepth] Optional pre-confirmed process depth.
28  * @param {string} [options.confirmedTier] Optional pre-confirmed model tier.
29  * @param {object} [options.triageLock] Optional pre-built lock record.
30  * @param {boolean} [options.headless]
31  * @param {object} [options.triageConfig]
32  * @returns {Promise<{ artifactPath, triageHash, decision, extension }>}
33  */
34 /**
35  * Load the latest locked (or advisory) intake extension from a runDir.
36  * Used by run-rounds / formal path to honor band knobs (maxRounds, includeAdjudication).
37  * @param {string} runDir
38  * @returns {null | { extension: object, path: string, locked: boolean }}
39  */
40 export function loadTriageExtensionFromRunDir(runDir) {
41   if (!runDir || !fs.existsSync(runDir)) return null;
42   let files;
43   try {
44     files = fs.readdirSync(runDir).filter((f) => /^triage-extension-.*\.json$/.test(f));
45   } catch {
46     return null;
47   }
48   if (!files.length) {
49     // Fall back: any triage-*.json with .extension
50     try {
51       const triageFiles = fs.readdirSync(runDir).filter((f) => /^triage-[a-f0-9]+\.json$/i.test(f));
52       for (const f of triageFiles.sort().reverse()) {
53         const p = path.join(runDir, f);
54         const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
55         if (data && data.extension) {
56           return {
57             extension: data.extension,
58             path: p,
59             locked: !!data.extension.locked,
60           };
61         }
62       }
63     } catch {
64       return null;
65     }
66     return null;
67   }
68   // Prefer newest by mtime
69   files.sort((a, b) => {
70     const sa = fs.statSync(path.join(runDir, a)).mtimeMs;
71     const sb = fs.statSync(path.join(runDir, b)).mtimeMs;
72     return sb - sa;
73   });
74   const p = path.join(runDir, files[0]);
75   try {
76     const extension = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
77     return { extension, path: p, locked: !!extension.locked };
78   } catch {
79     return null;
80   }
81 }

83 /**
84  * Formal / headless predicate for band-budget fail-closed.
85  * Explicit `headless:true` wins; `headless:false` disables env auto-detect;
86  * otherwise RESEARCHPRIME_HEADLESS=1|true marks RP formal headless.
87  *
88  * @param {object} [opts]
89  * @param {boolean} [opts.headless]
90  * @param {object} [opts.env]
91  * @returns {boolean}
92  */
93 export function isHeadlessFormal({ headless, env = process.env } = {}) {
94   if (headless === true) return true;
95   if (headless === false) return false;
96   const v = env?.RESEARCHPRIME_HEADLESS;
97   if (v === '1' || v === 'true' || v === true) return true;
98   return false;
99 }
100 
101 /**
102  * Resolve hard round budget from (explicit CLI > env > locked triage knobs > default).
103  *
104  * Sole budget resolver for run-rounds (Track B1 W3). includeAdjudication is NEVER
105  * taken from argv/env — extension knobs only. Under headless / formal fail-closed,
106  * missing extension or locked!==true throws HaltError (no source==='default' FULL
107  * knobs: cap=8, includeAdjudication=true). CLI maxRounds is not a lock substitute.
108  *
109  * @param {object} [opts]
110  * @param {string} [opts.runDir]
111  * @param {number|null} [opts.maxRounds]  explicit CLI --max-rounds only
112  * @param {object} [opts.env]
113  * @param {number} [opts.fallback=8]
114  * @param {boolean} [opts.headless]  force headless formal predicate
115  * @param {boolean} [opts.failClosed]  force fail-closed even if not headless (run-rounds formal path)
116  * @returns {{ cap: number, source: string, knobs: object|null, includeAdjudication: boolean, locked: boolean }}
117  */
118 export function resolveBandRoundBudget({
119   runDir = null,
120   maxRounds = null,
121   env = process.env,
122   fallback = 8,
123   headless,
124   failClosed,
125 } = {}) {
126   const loaded = runDir ? loadTriageExtensionFromRunDir(runDir) : null;
127   const knobs = loaded?.extension?.knobs && typeof loaded.extension.knobs === 'object'
128     ? loaded.extension.knobs
129     : null;
130   const locked = !!(loaded && (loaded.locked === true || loaded.extension?.locked === true));
131 
132   // Fail-closed: headless (or RP formal headless) OR explicit failClosed (run-rounds).
133   const formalClosed =
134     failClosed === true || isHeadlessFormal({ headless, env });
135 
136   if (formalClosed && (!loaded || locked !== true)) {
137     throw new HaltError(
138       'run-rounds band budget HALT: headless/formal path requires a locked triage extension ' +
139         '(missing extension or locked!==true). Refusing source=default FULL knobs ' +
140         `(cap=${fallback}, includeAdjudication=true). CLI/env maxRounds is not a lock substitute. ` +
141         'Gate-1 must emit triage-extension-*.json with locked:true before formal rounds.',
142       {
143         code: 'BAND_UNLOCKED_HEADLESS',
144         runDir,
145         hasExtension: !!loaded,
146         locked,
147       },
148     );
149   }
150 
151   // includeAdjudication: extension knobs ONLY — never --include-adjudication or env.
152   let includeAdjudication;
153   if (knobs && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(knobs, 'includeAdjudication')) {
154     includeAdjudication = !!knobs.includeAdjudication;
155   } else if (formalClosed) {
156     throw new HaltError(
157       'run-rounds band budget HALT: locked extension missing knobs.includeAdjudication — ' +
158         'refuse invented FULL adjudication default',
159       { code: 'BAND_MISSING_ADJUDICATION_KNOB', runDir },
160     );
161   } else {
162     // Interactive / non-formal soft path only (never under headless unlocked).
163     includeAdjudication = true;
164   }
165 
166   // Cap precedence: explicit maxRounds arg > RESEARCHPRIME_MAX_ROUNDS env > locked knobs > fallback.
167   // (CLI/env only apply after lock gate when formalClosed — already enforced above.)
168   if (maxRounds != null && Number.isFinite(Number(maxRounds)) && Number(maxRounds) > 0) {
169     return {
170       cap: Math.floor(Number(maxRounds)),
171       source: 'explicit',
172       knobs,
173       includeAdjudication,
174       locked,
175     };
176   }
177   const envRaw = env?.RESEARCHPRIME_MAX_ROUNDS;
178   if (envRaw != null && String(envRaw).trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(envRaw)) && Number(envRaw) > 0) {
179     return {
180       cap: Math.floor(Number(envRaw)),
181       source: 'env',
182       knobs,
183       includeAdjudication,
184       locked,
185     };
186   }
187   if (knobs && typeof knobs.maxRounds === 'number' && knobs.maxRounds > 0) {
188     return {
189       cap: Math.floor(knobs.maxRounds),
190       source: locked ? 'triage-lock' : 'triage-advisory',
191       knobs,
192       includeAdjudication,
193       locked,
194     };
195   }
196 
197   // Would invent source=default FULL knobs (cap=fallback, includeAdjudication often true).
198   if (formalClosed) {
199     throw new HaltError(
200       `run-rounds band budget HALT: refuse source=default FULL knobs (cap=${fallback}, ` +
201         'includeAdjudication=true) under headless/formal — locked extension lacks knobs.maxRounds',
202       { code: 'BAND_DEFAULT_REFUSED', runDir, locked },
203     );
204   }
205 
206   return {
207     cap: fallback,
208     source: 'default',
209     knobs,
210     includeAdjudication,
211     locked,
212   };
213 }

215 export async function runIntake(inputs, {
216   runDir,
217   promptHuman,
218   onBeforePrompt,
219   confirmedDepth,
220   confirmedTier,
221   triageLock,
222   headless,
223   triageConfig,
224 } = {}) {
225   const recommendation = recommendResearchPrimeIntake(inputs || {});
226 
227   // Pre-prompt extension: advisory knobs; locked:false until Gate-1 APPROVE / explicit lock.
228   const preExtension = buildResearchPrimeIntakeExtension(inputs || {}, {
229     recommendation,
230     confirmedDepth,
231     confirmedTier,
232     triageLock,
233     headless,
234     triageConfig,
235     requireLock: false,
236   });
237 
238   const triageData = {
239     inputs,
240     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
241     stamp: NS01_WAVE5_STAMP,
242     extension: preExtension,
243   };
244 
245   const triageStr = JSON.stringify(triageData, null, 2);
246   const triageHashStr = JSON.stringify({ inputs }, null, 2);
247   const triageHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(triageHashStr).digest('hex');
248 
249   fs.mkdirSync(runDir, { recursive: true });
250   const artifactPath = path.join(runDir, `triage-${triageHash}.json`);
251 
252   // Durably write the artifact BEFORE any prompt
253   fs.writeFileSync(artifactPath, triageStr, 'utf8');
254   // Dedicated extension surface (Wave-5 contract — greppable "extension" write)
255   const extensionPath = path.join(runDir, `triage-extension-${triageHash}.json`);
256   fs.writeFileSync(extensionPath, JSON.stringify(preExtension, null, 2), 'utf8');
257 
258   if (onBeforePrompt) {
259     await onBeforePrompt({ artifactPath, triageHash, extension: preExtension });
260   }
261 
262   let decision = 'ABORT';
263   if (promptHuman) {
264     decision = await promptHuman({ artifactPath, triageHash, extension: preExtension });
265   } else {
266     // Default interactive prompt
267     const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
268     const answer = await rl.question(
269       `Triage artifact written to ${artifactPath} (hash: ${triageHash}).\n` +
270         `Advisory: tier=${preExtension.recommendation.tier} depth=${preExtension.recommendation.depth}\n` +
271         `Gate 1 Decision (APPROVE, EDIT, ABORT)? `,
272     );
273     rl.close();
274     decision = answer.trim().toUpperCase();
275     if (!['APPROVE', 'EDIT', 'ABORT'].includes(decision)) {
276       decision = 'ABORT';
277     }
278   }
279 
280   // After Gate-1: lock extension when APPROVE (or when pre-locked via headless/lock).
281   let extension = preExtension;
282   if (decision === 'APPROVE' || triageLock || headless === true) {
283     extension = buildResearchPrimeIntakeExtension(inputs || {}, {
284       recommendation,
285       gate1Decision: decision === 'APPROVE' ? 'APPROVE' : undefined,
286       confirmedDepth,
287       confirmedTier,
288       triageLock,
289       headless,
290       triageConfig,
291       requireLock: headless === true,
292     });
293     fs.writeFileSync(extensionPath, JSON.stringify(extension, null, 2), 'utf8');
294     // Refresh main artifact with locked extension
295     fs.writeFileSync(
296       artifactPath,
297       JSON.stringify({ ...triageData, extension, gate1Decision: decision }, null, 2),
298       'utf8',
299     );
300   }
301 
302   // Triage-artifact hashing feeding the canonical governance record (partial record for Gate 1)
303   const governanceRecord = {
304     triageHash,
305     gate1Decision: decision,
306     triageExtensionStamp: extension?.stamp || NS01_WAVE5_STAMP,
307     triageDepth: extension?.triage?.depth || extension?.recommendation?.depth || null,
308     triageTier: extension?.triage?.tier || extension?.recommendation?.tier || null,
309   };
310   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDir, 'gate1-record.json'), JSON.stringify(governanceRecord, null, 2), 'utf8');
311 
312   if (decision === 'ABORT') {
313     throw new HaltError(`Run halted at Gate 1 with decision ABORT (Artifact: ${triageHash})`);
314   }
315 
316   return { artifactPath, triageHash, decision, extension, extensionPath };
317 }

319 function invokedDirectly() {
320   const entry = process.argv[1];
321   if (!entry) return false;
322   try { return path.resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) === path.resolve(entry); } catch { return false; }
323 }

325 if (invokedDirectly()) {
326   const runDir = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
327   // Collect stdin for inputs in a real scenario, but for now just mock it
328   const inputs = { note: 'interactive intake' };
329   runIntake(inputs, { runDir }).then(res => {
330     console.log('Intake complete:', res);
331   }).catch(err => {
332     if (err instanceof HaltError) {
333       console.error(err.message);
334       process.exit(1);
335     }
336     console.error(err);
337     process.exit(2);
338   });
